item: Sink sweep slice 5: every remaining src package reads a caught exception through record_text or engine_text
summary: The sweep now covers every remaining package of src (ai_layer, analytics, catalog, config, custody, entities, events, geo, hazards, jobs, law, llm, markets, osm, safety, services, stats, testing, utils, verification, versioned, weather and the top-level modules). A text stored or served from a caught exception goes through record_text (a database driver's error anywhere in the chain is the class only) or engine_text; the sites that only classify an exception are listed with their reason. Background jobs also expose a pool_timeout flag so no caller reads words. The records guard reads all of src and fails on a new record built from an exception's text.
